An orientation into modern LLMs: a brief history, what actually changed, and your first hands-on API calls.

## Chapter Materials

- [Lesson](lesson.qmd) — written walkthrough with references
- [Notebook](notebook.ipynb) — runnable exercises
- [Video](video.qmd) — recordings


## Readings

### Optional But Recommended


**Understanding LLMs** 

- [Google LLM Crash Course](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/crash-course/llm) — Clear explanation of what LLMs are, how they work at a high level

**Tokenization**

- [OpenAI's Tokenizer Tool](https://platform.openai.com/tokenizer) — Interactive tool to see how text becomes tokens
- [Hugging Face NLP Course: Tokenizers](https://huggingface.co/learn/nlp-course/chapter2/4) — Understanding why tokenization matters

**Temperature & Sampling** (15 min)

- [OpenRouter's Model Parameters Guide](https://openrouter.ai/docs/parameters) — Explains temperature, top-p, and other sampling parameters

**Tool Use / Function Calling** (10 min)

- [OpenAI's Function Calling Guide](https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/function-calling) — How LLMs work with arbitrary tools/functions
